name: Shotacon Ryoubo-san ni Kawaigarareru Subarashiki Hibi
original_name: ショタコン寮母さんに可愛がられる素晴らしき日々

That's why everyone wanted to live in this dorm. She was mother to us all.

Follow the story as protagonist Youta, who becomes the special sexual prey of the "dorm mother" at boarding school.
